title: spec.config.json — per-repo single source of variability
description: Every generated <app>-specs/ repo has ONE spec.config.json at its root. The engine (tools/specs.mjs) and every skill read it. Change a domain/status/role here and NOWHERE else (fixes optis' 'edit 3 places' coupling).

app.description: App folder / identity. Uses the app- prefix, e.g. app-checkout.

language.description: Output language the skills WRITE specs/docs in (e.g. 'vi' | 'en'). Skills & rules are authored in English; this controls generated content.

template.description: Which template this repo was generated from, pinned by version: '<name>@<semver>', e.g. 'default@1.0.0'. Enables a future update/migration path.

roles.description: The roles that own files / drive the status lifecycle, e.g. ['ba','dev','tester']. Rules & templates must NOT hard-code role names — read them from here.

domains.description: Top-level capability categories. A feature ID is [DOMAIN]-<slug>. If non-empty, `check` enforces that every feature ID starts with one of these. Leave [] for free-form IDs.

statuses.description: Allowed feature.meta.status values (spec lifecycle). Ordered draft→live by convention.

shipped_statuses.description: The subset of `statuses` that mean 'code is in production'. `check` warns if such a feature still has acceptance_stage: happy. Default ['implemented','live'].

change_types.description: Allowed change.meta.type values. 'Add' creates a feature on fold; the rest patch. Default ['Add','Modify','Remove','Fix'].

acceptance_stages.description: Allowed acceptance_stage values (test-suite maturity), orthogonal to status. Default ['happy','full'].

repos.description: Code repo keys a feature may anchor to via related_code '<repo>:<path>'. If non-empty, `check` enforces the prefix.
